content.short: Monetrix issues USDM, a yield-bearing stable token native to Hyperliquid.
content.description: Monetrix issues USDM, a stable token that accrues yield to its holder and is backed by basis trading positions rather than by fiat reserves held off-chain. Delta-neutral stablecoins of this design pay well while funding rates are positive, and their behaviour when funding turns negative is the question that determines whether they last.
